title: A model or provider alias never names another maker's model
steps: S1: check alias words against a route's own names: another maker's, its own, one the model id names, a word inside another.
S2: build the picker catalogue and the model identity from a DeepSeek route aliased "Claude Opus 5.5" under provider alias "Anthropic", and an OpenRouter Claude model aliased "Claude Sonnet".
expect: S1: claude, gpt and gemini are refused where the route does not name them; DeepSeek on DeepSeek, Claude on an anthropic/ model id and "Immersive" pass.
S2: the DeepSeek route shows DeepSeek and DeepSeek Flash; the OpenRouter route keeps Tracy AI and Claude Sonnet.
evidence: Issue #249: the picker named "Claude Opus 5.5" for the deepseek-flash route on dev

tests: an alias that names another maker is never shown: the model and provider keep their own names (#249)
